description: How many households in a service area fit a contractor's trade, judged from property signals (tree canopy, slope, lot size, pool) rather than just addresses. Free, no key needed. Returns the count, the price to buy, and a link where the user can buy the list in one step.

city.description: City name at the center of the service area, with state. Alternative to zip.

lat.description: Latitude of the center of the service area (alternative to zip)

lng.description: Longitude of the center of the service area (alternative to zip)

radiusMiles.description: Service radius in miles, 0.5 to 50. A typical contractor uses 15 to 25.

recipientMode.description: Who the mail is addressed to. "owner_property" (default) uses the owner's name and mails it to the property. "owner" uses the owner's name and mails it to the owner's own address, which reaches absentee and out-of-state landlords. "resident" addresses Current Resident at the property. Leave it out unless the user says what they want.

trade.description: The contractor's trade. One of: tree-services, forestry-mulching, land-services, lawn-care, landscaping, hardscaping, roofing, pest-control, pool-services. For any other home or property service use generic-other.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code at the center of the service area. Easiest way to say where. Send this, OR city and state, OR lat and lng.

name: count_homes
title: Count matching homes
